# Alalam Drug Store (مستودع العلم للأدوية)

> Licensed pharmaceutical distributor based in Amman, Jordan, supplying pharmacies, clinics and healthcare providers with dependable, properly-handled medicine and medical products.

Alalam Drug Store (Arabic: مستودع العلم للأدوية) is a licensed pharmaceutical distribution company operating in Amman, Jordan. It is registered with Jordan's Ministry of Health (MoH) and operates in line with Jordan Food and Drug Administration (JFDA) requirements. The company connects pharmacies and clinics across Jordan with the medicines and medical products they depend on — sourced from established manufacturers, stored and transported under the conditions they require, and delivered on time.

## Company details

- Name (English): Alalam Drug Store
- Also written as: Al-Alam Drug Store, Aalam Drug Store, Alam Pharma
- Name (Arabic): مستودع العلم للأدوية
- Industry: Pharmaceutical distribution / drug store (wholesale)
- Location: Khalil Dabbas St. 10, Amman, Jordan
- Phone / WhatsApp: +962 79 999 8825
- Hours: Sunday–Thursday, 9:00–18:00 (Jordan time)
- Languages: Arabic, English

## What we do

- Pharmaceutical supply — a wide catalogue of licensed medicines from established manufacturers.
- Medical supplies — consumables and equipment for pharmacies, clinics and healthcare providers.
- Cosmetics & personal care — dermatological and personal-care product lines.
- Distribution & logistics — timely, well-handled delivery across Jordan with clear communication at every step.

## Regulatory & compliance

- Registered with Jordan's Ministry of Health (MoH).
- Operates in line with Jordan Food and Drug Administration (JFDA) requirements.
- Products are stored and transported under the handling conditions they require.
